clean_story: "Rest for the body. Reset for the brain. The term sleep science comes from studying how rest affects our health and mind. Most think sleep is just downtime, but the brain stays active, cycling through stages like a nightly maintenance routine. Deep sleep washes away toxins like a janitor cleaning a school at night. REM sleep, where dreams happen, helps sort memories like filing papers into drawers. Without it, focus fades and mood sours. Sleep deprivation slows reaction time more than being drunk. Some animals, like dolphins, sleep with half their brain awake to keep swimming and breathing. Three related subjects are dreams, circadian rhythms and sleep disorders."
